name: toranly
description: Toranly: celebration and event planner. One command per task for the web app and the backend.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix web ci && uv sync --directory backend
scripts.lint: uv run --directory backend ruff check . && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check . && npm --prefix web run lint
scripts.typecheck: uv run --directory backend mypy && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.test: uv run --directory backend pytest -m "not live" && npm --prefix web test
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.coverage: uv run --directory backend pytest -m "not live" -q --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered && npm --prefix web run test:coverage
